_comment: DEFAULT SEED / documentation only. Live per-platform flags are managed in the internal dashboard (Cloudflare KV, edited at https://dashboard.cumulusvpn.com/admin) and served at https://dashboard.cumulusvpn.com/api/flags, which the app fetches at launch. If the app can't fetch flags it fails closed to OFF. Seed KV from this file (values below, without the _comment keys).
_comment_inAppUpgrade: CRYPTO purchase UI (QR + wallet hand-off + FLUX price). A store-policy violation if shown in store builds (Apple 3.1.1 / Google Play Payments), so store builds MUST keep this OFF — when OFF the app shows no crypto purchase UI at all. Enable only for direct-APK / off-store Android builds, and NEVER while a Play build from the same binary is live (they share the flag endpoint). This flag is now the ONLY gate on both platforms: the previous build-level iOS exclusion in clients/mobile/src/lib/flags.ts is gone, so 'ios': true DOES take effect on an App Store build at its next launch. Treat that as a deliberate compliance decision.
_comment_iapPurchase: STORE-BILLING purchase UI (Apple IAP / Google Play Billing subscriptions via the payments bridge, docs/18-payments-bridge.md). Store-compliant by construction — this flag is a rollout/kill switch, NOT a compliance shield. It MUST be ON in KV for a platform BEFORE a build containing the subscribe UI is submitted for review (reviewers must find the declared subscriptions; fail-closed flags would hide them and cause a rejection), and may be flipped OFF afterwards only as an emergency kill switch (bridge outage).
_comment_voucherRedeem: In-app redeem box for OUR voucher/promo codes (docs/18). Per-platform and remote-controlled on both: the build-level iOS exclusion in flags.ts is gone, so 'ios': true takes effect. Android direct-APK and Play ship the SAME binary, so this flag is the only thing separating them — keep OFF in KV while a Play build is live. Users can always redeem our codes on the web (Settings shows a Device code); the store-sanctioned offer-code sheets are separate and ride with iapPurchase, not this flag.
